stemMd: Nora is older than Omar. Priya is younger than Omar but older than Quinn. Who is youngest?
explanationMd: Combine the comparisons into Nora > Omar > Priya > Quinn in age. The last person in this decreasing order is Quinn. No numerical ages are needed because the relative order is fully specified.

distractorRationale.c: Nora is older than Omar, who is older than Priya and Quinn.
distractorRationale.a: Priya and Quinn are younger than Omar.
distractorRationale.d: Quinn is explicitly younger than Priya.
distractorRationale.e: The comparisons form a complete age order.
